class ScopeBase {}
class InitializedScope extends ScopeBase {
  constructor(public x = 1) { var x = 2; super(); }
}
class AssignedScope extends ScopeBase {
  constructor(public x = 1) { var x: number; x = 3; super(); }
}
class BlockScope extends ScopeBase {
  constructor(public x = 1) { var x = 4; { const x = 40; super(); console.log(x); } }
}
class ParameterClosureScope extends ScopeBase {
  constructor(public x = 1, read = () => x) { var x = 6; super(); console.log(read(), x); }
}
console.log(new InitializedScope());
console.log(new AssignedScope());
console.log(new BlockScope());
console.log(new ParameterClosureScope());
